start: The desk tapped 'Request workout report' on this member's page; the gym's server has 0045; Gym tab online

steps.action: Open the Gym tab, look at the plan card
user_sees: 'Send your report to the gym?'
'<gym> wants a copy of your workouts from <join date>, the day you joined: exercises, sets, weights, reps and your notes. The gym owner and desk can see it. …'
Buttons 'Yes, send it' and 'No'
'Want your own copy? Go to Settings and save all your workouts.'
must_not: The ask shown on an offline (kept) plan card
Workouts from before the join date offered

user_sees: 'Sending your report…' and the button busy
must_not: Two reports sent for one ask
The report sent to another gym

user_sees: 'Report sent to the gym.' in green; the ask is gone
must_not: 'Report sent' when the file did not reach the gym

start: The yes reached the gym but the file was lost on the way (internet dropped after step 1)

user_sees: The same ask, the main button now 'Try again'
must_not: The ask gone with no report at the gym
A second yes recorded

user_sees: 'Report sent to the gym.'
must_not: The phone asking the member to agree a second time

start: The ask is waiting; the member does not want to share

user_sees: 'OK. Nothing was sent to the gym.'
must_not: Any workout data sent
The ask coming back on the next visit

start: The ask is waiting; no internet

user_sees: 'Couldn't send it. Check your internet and try again.' in red
must_not: 'Report sent to the gym.'
The buttons left disabled

steps.action: The desk cancels the ask meanwhile; internet back; tap 'Try again'
user_sees: A plain line that the request is gone, and the card reads the request again
must_not: A report sent for a cancelled ask

steps.action: Leave the Gym tab and come back
user_sees: No ask on the plan card
must_not: The same ask again, inviting a second report

steps.action: The desk asks again next month
user_sees: The ask shows again with the join date
must_not: The old 'Report sent to the gym.' line kept instead
